scope.question: Given the delivered feed state, the RF electrical input, the registered ICP geometry and electrodes and the thermal boundary, which steady plasma state does the downstream 13.56 MHz ICP reach; how much electron current can it deliver to a registered electron sink; where does its input power go; and what does it draw from the bus and the feed? Every quantity carries an explicit status where evidence is missing.
scope.model_class: steady-state, volume-averaged (global, 0-D) inductive discharge model: species particle balances, one electron energy balance (Maxwellian electrons), Bohm-flux surface losses with registered edge-to-centre factors, an explicit electrode current balance for electron extraction, and an RF coupling representation in three declared modes (CM-ABS, CM-CAL, CM-PRED).
scope.selected_architecture: hall_icp_neutralizer: one Hall accelerator + one downstream 13.56 MHz RF/ICP electron source / neutralizer (open-tube coaxial first build, unmagnetized ICP), no conventional hollow cathode; supply modes AIR_PRIMARY and XE_CONTINGENCY (A9, A9.19, A9.20; config/architecture/hall_icp_neutralizer_v1.json).
what_it_is_not: not a Hall discharge model (HallThruster.jl is authoritative, A9.28 msg 2 sec. 7)
not a plume, beam-neutralization or Hall-beam / ICP interaction model (CFG-FLIGHT-HALL-ON is NOT_EVALUATED in v1)
not an ignition, start-up, transient, E-mode (capacitive) or hysteresis-path model
not a thermal model (it supplies heat terms to NP-THERMAL-CATHODELESS)
not an assessment (no threshold, margin verdict or compliance label)
not a geometry-search surrogate for F6 before validation (A9.14 F6-OQ-03)

exclusions.rule: No wholesale port of abep_sim/plasma_chem.py (HISTORICAL_LEGACY_MODULE, A9.28 msg 1 sec. 3; A9.29 sec. 4). Nothing is taken from it: not the RATES Arrhenius fits, not the EPS_C (eps_c = a + b/T_e) fits, not E_DISS, not the Chamber default h_l = 0.4, not magnetised_wall_factor, not solve_global. Shared kernels (Bohm flux, Maxwellian rate from cross sections, particle / power balance structure) come from the primary sources cited here and, for the rate integral, from the separately admitted abep-chem port of rate_tables.maxwellian_rate (SC-WP-03).

No LaB6, hollow-cathode, thermionic-emitter, keeper or emitter-heater element (A9.19; A9.20; A9.24 cathode-path audit). Forbidden identifiers in abep-icp: LaB6, hollow_cathode, keeper, heater, c1_ (scan in CI, plan SC-WP-05 admission precedent).

No ECR, no upstream RF pre-ionizer and no legacy stage-1 topology (A9 supersession; A9.29 sec. 4). The historical interstage lane is used only as a registry of already-cited sources (Lieberman 2015 slides, Chiggiato 2014); no code, closure, case or topology is inherited.
No archengine rf_cathode or mw_air card and no golden_v1/v2 neutralizer value (cathode audit O-2 and O-3).

Raw outputs contain no requirement threshold, no HC-05 PASS/FAIL, no GNG-ICP-01 verdict, no RVM status and no RFP compliance label. abep-icp parses no RFP clause and never depends on abep-assess (A9.22; A9.24 item 5; A9.29 sec. 4).
C1 is GROUND_REFERENCE_ONLY. It is not modelled. C1-based evidence enters only as a registered measured I_d,max,H1 on the Hall side of IF-ICP-HALL-v1 (A9.20).
abep-icp never depends on GROUND_TEST_PROGRAMME_ONLY code (abep-groundtest; A9.29 sec. 1). Bench records (P1/P2) enter only as versioned, sha256-pinned evidence data files read through a schema.

No invented coupling efficiency, impedance, extraction efficiency, stable operating region, edge-to-centre factor, wall coefficient, cross section, conductance, generator efficiency or temperature. A missing value gives the status defined in status_vocabulary, never a default (A9.29 sec. 4; CLAUDE.md rules 3 and 6).
No Ar result is transferred into N2, air or flight evidence (A9.25 sec. 10).
No Hall transport closure is used; screening candidates sgb-screen-01..09 never enter (credible set EMPTY).
Model outputs never drive the F6 geometry search before the model is validated on built geometries (A9.14 S7.8 F6-OQ-03).

v1 does not represent Hall-beam ions crossing the ICP volume, their charge exchange in the ICP, or their collection on ICP surfaces. These belong to CFG-FLIGHT-HALL-ON and to the Hall plume interface (NOT_EVALUATED).

equations.name: neutral particle balance, FLOW_BALANCE mode
equations.form: 0 = Gamma_in,k + Gamma_bg,k + V sum_r nu_r,k R_r + sum_j sum_s w_s,k Gamma_i,s,j A_j - sum_j (1/4) n_k vbar_k A_open,j tau_j - (gamma_k / 2) (1/4) n_k vbar_k A_wall (atom wall recombination, products credited to the molecule); vbar_k = (8 k_B T_g / (pi M_k))^(1/2); Gamma_bg,k = (1/4) n_b,k vbar_b,k sum_j A_open,j
equations.source: Chiggiato 2014 (arXiv:1404.0960) Eq. 3 (mean speed), Eq. 13 (aperture conductance), Eqs. 19-21 (tube transmission, Santeler form), sec. 2.1 (impingement), Table 7 (Kn > 0.5); registered in docs/architecture_comparison/interstage/INTERSTAGE_MODEL.md sec. 7
equations.notes: R_r = k_r(T_e) n_e n_target,r is the volume event rate density [m^-3 s^-1]; w_s,k are element-conserving wall-neutralization products declared per ion; Gamma_in,k from IN-04 x f_in (IN-12). G-REUSE in CFG-CAP-OFF: Gamma_in is the delivered feed passing through the H-1 gas path with the discharge OFF (no Hall ionization).

equations.name: ion particle balance and quasi-neutrality
equations.form: V sum_r nu_r,s R_r = sum_j Gamma_i,s,j A_j for every ion species s; n_e = sum_s Z_s n_i,s (no negative ions in v1)
equations.source: Lieberman 2015 short course slides 41 and 44 (flux h n u_B; registered); global-model structure as in Lieberman & Lichtenberg 2005 ch. 10 (verify, VER-01)
equations.notes: Every rate uses the bulk densities (uniform-profile volume term), every surface flux the edge density h_j n: a model-form assumption of global models.

equations.name: Bohm speed
equations.source: Lieberman 2015 slide 41 for Z = 1 (registered); Z > 1 is the isothermal cold-ion generalization (model-derived; verify, VER-08)

equations.name: edge-to-centre factors (registered; no default)
equations.form: H-LIEB: h_R = 0.8 (4 + R/lambda_i)^(-1/2) for radial surfaces, h_L = 0.86 (3 + L/(2 lambda_i))^(-1/2) for axial surfaces, lambda_i = 1/(n_g sigma_i); H-EXPLICIT: sourced h_j per surface
equations.source: Lieberman 2015 slides 38, 43, 44 (formula text and locators recorded in abep_sim/interstage.py h_radial_lieberman / h_axial_lieberman and in INTERSTAGE_MODEL.md sec. 7)
equations.domain: B = 0, cylinder, total pressure < 100 mTorr (slide 44, argon). Use for N2, O, Xe is an extrapolation of the source's argon statement: evidence level 6, carried in provenance
equations.notes: An open tube end is treated as an axial surface with h_L (assumption; VER-07). sigma_i is TBD (IN-17).

equations.name: rate coefficients
equations.form: k_r(T_e) = <sigma_r v> over a Maxwellian EEDF at temperature T_e, evaluated from the registered source representation of each table (cross section -> Maxwellian integral with the table's tail convention; analytic rate fit -> direct evaluation), i.e. the same data and transformation chain as the registered .dat table, which is tabulated against mean energy 3/2 T_e
equations.source: per-table sources in hallthruster_bridge/propellants/PROVENANCE.md; integral convention abep_sim/rate_tables.py::maxwellian_rate (ported through the abep-chem parity contract, SC-WP-03)
equations.notes: Direct evaluation is chosen because the registered .dat tables are on a 1 eV mean-energy grid and threshold rates vary steeply at ICP-class mean energies (e.g. ionization_N2_song2023.dat: 6.4e-20 m^3/s at 2 eV, 4.4e-18 at 3 eV). The .dat interpolation is computed as a cross-check and its difference is reported per reaction (UQ-06). Maxwellian EEDF is a model-form assumption (DOM-13).

equations.name: electron energy balance
equations.form: P_abs = V e n_e [ sum_r n_target,r k_r E_r + sum_k n_k k_m,k (3 m_e / M_k)(T_e - T_g) ] + sum_j e A_j [ Gamma_e,j (2 T_e + max(0, phi_p - V_j)) + Gamma_i,j (T_e / 2) ] (+ open boundaries as surfaces)
equations.source: inelastic sum: reaction-resolved with the registered thresholds E_r (table headers); per-electron 2 T_e: Lieberman 2015 slide 50 and Goebel & Katz 2008 Eqs. 7.3-47, 7.3-61 (registered); ion presheath T_e/2: Lieberman 2015 slide 48 and Goebel & Katz 2008 Eq. 4.2-10 (registered); retarding-barrier energy removed from the electron population: model-derived (this preregistration; checked by LC-02 against the floating-wall form); elastic term 3 m_e/M form: verify (VER-02)
equations.notes: Electrons crossing a retarding barrier phi_p - V_j lose that energy to the potential structure; at a floating surface the ions recover exactly that energy (Gamma_e = Gamma_i), at a biased electrode the difference is exchanged with the external supply (EQ-16 closure). For all-floating surfaces the per-pair loss reduces to 2 T_e + T_e/2 + V_s (Lieberman 2015 slides 48, 50).

equations.name: floating-surface sheath
equations.form: sum_s Z_s h n_i,s u_B,s = (1/4) h n_e vbar_e exp(-V_s / T_e); vbar_e = (8 e T_e / (pi m_e))^(1/2); single species: V_s = (T_e / 2) ln(M / (2 pi m_e))
equations.source: Lieberman 2015 slide 48 (registered; 'V_s ~ 4.7 T_e for argon'); multi-species form model-derived (as recorded in INTERSTAGE_MODEL.md sec. 2)

equations.name: electrode surface fluxes
equations.form: ions to a surface at V_j < phi_p: Gamma_i,s,j = h_j n_i,s u_B,s; electrons: Gamma_e,j = (1/4) h_j n_e vbar_e exp(-(phi_p - V_j)/T_e) for V_j <= phi_p, and (1/4) h_j n_e vbar_e (electron saturation) for V_j > phi_p, ions then repelled (Gamma_i,j = 0)
equations.source: random flux (1/4) n vbar_e and Boltzmann retardation: Lieberman 2015 slide 48 (registered); electron-sheath regime, its presheath and the global non-ambipolar area condition: Baalrud, Hershkowitz and Longmier 2007 (verify, VER-06)
equations.status: retarding branch REGISTERED; electron-saturation branch verify

equations.name: global current balance (defines phi_p)
equations.form: sum_j I_j = 0 with I_j = e A_j (sum_s Z_s Gamma_i,s,j - Gamma_e,j); every floating dielectric or floating conductor has I_j = 0 individually; open boundaries carry zero net current (declared assumption)
equations.source: charge conservation (Kirchhoff); owner sign convention CONVENTIONAL_CURRENT_INTO_THE_DEFINED_ISOLATED_ELECTRICAL_NETWORK_IS_POSITIVE (A9.5, P1-IT-48) is applied in the comparison adapter, not inside the model

equations.name: I_e,cap and its bounds (CFG-CAP-OFF)
equations.form: I_e_cap_A = e A_ec (Gamma_e,ec - sum_s Z_s Gamma_i,s,ec) at the registered bias: the net electron current to the registered electron-collecting electrode, signed, never clipped. Exact consequences of EQ-03 and EQ-10: I_e_cap_A <= (1/4) e h_ec n_e vbar_e A_ec (electron thermal-flux limit); I_e_cap_A = sum_{j != ec} I_j <= e sum_{j in ion-collecting electrodes} sum_s Z_s h_j n_i,s u_B,s A_j (ion-collection limit); I_e_cap_A <= I_production_A = e V sum_ionizing R_r (charge-conservation limit). I_e_sat_A = maximum of I_e_cap_A over the registered bias range up to V_bias,max.
equations.source: owner measurand A9.4 P1Q-10 / A9.5 P1Q-16 / P1-IT-38 (mapping); bounds are model-derived from EQ-03, EQ-09, EQ-10
equations.notes: Facility background electron current is not modelled; the model quantity corresponds to the RF-OFF-corrected measurand I_e,collector,RFON - I_e,collector,RFOFF. No extraction efficiency appears anywhere: extraction follows from the registered electrode areas, potentials and the current balance.

equations.name: RF chain relations and coupling efficiency
equations.form: P_delivered = P_fwd - P_refl - P_line_match_loss (at RP-ANT); P_delivered = I_ant,rms^2 (R_ant + R_p); eta_p = R_p / (R_p + R_ant); P_abs = eta_p P_delivered; Q_coil_ohmic = I_ant,rms^2 R_ant
equations.source: A9.2 P_delivered definition (P2 RP-CPL record); Takahashi et al. 2024 Eq. (1), p. 7-8, eta_p = R_p / (R_p + R_ant) with R_p = R_total - R_ant (TK-24..TK-26, registered); ZM-C resistance split (P2)
equations.notes: R_ant is the whole non-plasma antenna-circuit resistance at RP-ANT; it includes induced (eddy) losses in nearby conductors (Takahashi TK-27: most RF power heated the ion-collecting electrode). The location split of Q_coil_ohmic is a registered input or NOT_EVALUATED (IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1). Plane convention: R_ant and the power must refer to the same plane and the convention is registered per case, never mixed. RP-ANT convention (required for IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1): R_ant = P_delivered / I_ant^2 without plasma, P_abs = eta_p P_delivered. R_vac convention (P2 ZM-C note RF-TAKA22-03; VI-RF-05 / VI-RF-06): R_ant = P_net / I_ant^2 without plasma lumps line and match loss into R_ant and P_abs = eta_p P_net; a case in this convention emits Q_icp_line_W and Q_icp_match_W as NOT_EVALUATED (lumped into Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W, flag LUMPED_R_VAC).

equations.name: CALIBRATED coupling
equations.form: R_p(op) = Re Z_antenna,hot(op) - R_ant,cold; X(op) = Im Z_antenna,hot(op); taken from the registered P2 map at the operating point; between map points only the P2-registered interpolation rule; P_line_match_loss from the P2 two-port at the logged tuning state
equations.source: P2 framework (ZM-A primary, ZM-B mandatory cross-check, ZM-C resistance cross-check; A9.11 P2Q-01; A9.14 P2Q-06)
equations.domain: inside the map; plasma_state_class H_MODE; uncertainty status EVALUATED (DOM-08, DOM-09)

equations.name: PREDICTIVE coupling (transformer model) and self-consistent equilibria
equations.form: The plasma is the one-turn secondary of an air-core transformer whose primary is the coil. Secondary resistance R_2 and inductance L_2 = L_mp + L_p follow from the plasma conductivity sigma_p = e^2 n_e / (m_e (nu_m + j omega)), nu_m = sum_k n_k k_m,k, the skin depth and the registered geometry; mutual inductance L_12 couples it to the coil. Transferred impedance at the coil: R_s = omega^2 L_12^2 R_2 / (R_2^2 + omega^2 L_2^2), X_s = omega L_11 - omega^3 L_12^2 L_2 / (R_2^2 + omega^2 L_2^2); R_p = R_s. Equilibria: all n_e > 0 with P_abs(n_e) [EQ-12 with R_p(n_e)] = P_loss(n_e) [EQ-07] on the registered root-scan grid, plus the trivial n_e = 0 branch; each is classified by the sign of d(P_abs - P_loss)/dn_e.
equations.source: Piejak, Godyak and Alexandrovich 1992; Lieberman & Lichtenberg 2005 ch. 12 (all formula detail from memory: verify, VER-03); stochastic heating not included in v1 (VER-04); slope stability criterion (VER-05); hysteresis context Turner & Lieberman 1999 (cited in the repository failure tree; content not read here, VER-17)
equations.domain: geometric assumptions as stated by the source (VER-03); H-mode only; outside -> OUT_OF_DOMAIN
equations.status: NOT ADMISSIBLE until VER-03, VER-04, VER-05 are cleared

equations.name: bus-plane conversion
equations.form: P_RF,DC = (P_fwd - P_refl) / eta_RF; P_bias,DC = V_bias I_bias / eta_bias; P_icp_bus_W = P_RF,DC + P_match,DC + P_bias,DC (+ installed variant slots icp_assist_magnet, flow_control_icp_feed)
equations.source: VI-RF-09 definition eta_RF = P_net / P_RF,DC (validation inputs, owner row 108); bus_power_boundary_a9_v2 slot definitions

equations.name: energy partition definitions and closures
equations.form: RF chain: P_fwd = P_refl + Q_line + Q_match + Q_coil_ohmic + P_abs. RF-powered plasma: P_abs = Q_plasma_wall + Q_extraction + Q_radiation + Q_outflow_upstream + Q_outflow_downstream (surface terms L_j). Bias supply: P_collector_bias = -sum_j I_j V_j = sum_j C_j = Q_bias_collector + Q_bias_export, with C_j = I_j (phi_p - V_j) (I_j = net positive current from the plasma into surface j, V_j its potential against the reference). Per surface Q_j = L_j + C_j exactly (IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1 attribution_convention). Every term is computed from the converged state; none is defined as the closure remainder.
equations.source: energy conservation (CLAUDE.md rule 4); surface energy per particle per EQ-07 / Goebel & Katz 2008 (registered); formation energies EQ-18
equations.notes: Excitation energy goes to Q_radiation or Q_plasma_wall per IN-23; UNRESOLVED channels produce the bounding pair ALL_RADIATED / ALL_WALL. Elastic and vibrational/rotational energy given to neutrals is deposited on the walls at T_wall (assumption: neutrals thermalize with the walls, T_g input) or carried out with outflowing neutrals in proportion to their loss channels.

equations.name: gas consumption and conversion
equations.form: G-REUSE: mdot_icp_dedicated,s = 0 exactly (owner rule, not computed). G-ATM / G-XE: the registered dedicated flow is echoed with provenance. Conversion (raw output): dmdot_s = M_s V sum_r nu_r,s R_r (species created / destroyed inside the ICP).
equations.source: A9.1 HIQ-06 and HIQ-06 accounting; ICD ICP-26

equations.name: formation-energy bookkeeping
equations.form: energy reference: ground-state neutral molecules / atoms of the delivered feed; ionization and dissociation energies from the registered table headers (thresholds) and the registered NIST values; formation energy created in the volume is deposited where the species recombines (wall, Q_plasma_wall) or carried out (outflow / extraction terms)
equations.source: registered thresholds (rate table headers; PROVENANCE.md); wall neutralization energy convention: verify (VER-12, same status as abep_sim/icp_thermal_lib.q_collector surface terms)

chemistry.semantics: Mirrors the repository chemistry_trustworthy rule (CLAUDE.md next-work 5; rate_validity.toml). Every rate file used needs a rate_validity.toml entry: status verified with a mean-energy limit, or unresolved. A missing entry is a model error, never a default. In this 0-D model the activity n_e n_target k_r of a reaction lies wholly inside or wholly beyond its limit, so any active reaction with 3/2 T_e above its max_mean_energy_eV makes the result OUT_OF_DOMAIN (activity share beyond limit > 1e-12). Values are never extrapolated silently. An unresolved file makes the result INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE. chemistry_trustworthy certifies table validity, not completeness.

output_rules: Every output carries its own status. An output that depends on a NOT_EVALUATED or INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE input has that status even when the plasma solve converged.
A non-CONVERGED output carries value null: no number is reported for it (no half-converged state; CLAUDE.md rule 3).
Raw outputs never contain a threshold, margin verdict, HC id, GNG id, RVM status or RFP label (EX-05; FC-11).
Outputs computed from SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY inputs carry that label and can never be read as evidence.

status_vocabulary.CONVERGED: all equations solved to TOL-SOLVE, every conservation check within TOL-CONS, every domain check passed, every required input registered. Includes plasma_state NOT_SUSTAINED when no positive-density steady state exists inside the domain (e.g. P_abs = 0).
status_vocabulary.MODEL_ERROR: non-convergence, a non-finite value, a conservation residual above TOL-CONS, a missing rate_validity entry, or an internal contract breach. All physics values null.
status_vocabulary.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: an input or the converged state lies outside a declared validity domain (DOM-01, 02, 04, 05, 08, 09, 10, 11). Values null; the violated check is named.
status_vocabulary.NOT_EVALUATED: a determining external input or registration is absent: bench evidence (P1/P2), the Hall-side demand, an admitted Hall member, an owner registration, an upstream Rust component. The quantity is not computed.
status_vocabulary.INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE: the model could compute but a required source, table, cross section, geometry, domain criterion or evidence attribute is missing or unresolved. The quantity is withheld.
status_vocabulary.evaluation_order: (1) input registration -> NOT_EVALUATED / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; (2) input domain -> OUT_OF_DOMAIN; (3) solve -> MODEL_ERROR on failure; (4) solution domain -> OUT_OF_DOMAIN; (5) conservation -> MODEL_ERROR; (6) CONVERGED
status_vocabulary.no_other_states: No PASS, FAIL, OK, PARTIAL, APPROXIMATE or half-converged state exists in raw output.

IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.purpose: couple RF/ICP losses into the cathodeless thermal model NP-THERMAL-CATHODELESS (A9.29 sec. 4)
IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.consumer_record: docs/rust_migration/new_physics/NP-THERMAL-CATHODELESS/prereg_v1.json and PREREG.md, committed in c093ff2 (lock sha256: prereg_v1.json 7bd3bf074e0dfcf95586b8ae080fa630a4556443feb272b6b7c157c3bee926ad, PREREG.md a3fbca02239577232793cb85dbef9148b6dd9951903a7008b87fd5748b5603d8): keys IK-01..IK-07, checks IFI-1..IFI-5, energy-source rule HS-00, open alignment OQ-NPT-02, interface gap CF-04
IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.supply_attribution_rule: Each watt enters through the interface of the supply that powers it; no watt enters twice (consumer HS-00). The five deposited prescribed keys (Q_icp_plasma_wall_W, Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W, Q_icp_match_W, Q_icp_extraction_W, Q_icp_radiation_W) are RF-powered only; the producer declares rf_powered_only = true (enables consumer IFI-5) and every one of them is >= 0 (consumer IFI-2).
IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.hall_powered_heat_excluded: Q_icp_plasma_wall_W never contains heating driven by the Hall discharge-current return through the neutralizer (ICD ICP-43 discharge-path term, carried on the Hall side as IF-HALL-THERMAL-v1 Q_hall_return_to_icp_W) nor Hall plume interception (ICD ICP-29, carried as Q_hall_plume_to_icp_W). In v1 the Hall discharge is OFF in CFG-CAP-OFF, so no such term exists; CFG-FLIGHT-HALL-ON is NOT_EVALUATED; a v2 Hall-ON sub-model keeps this rule.
IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.attribution_convention: Per surface j (model-derived, exact): deposited heat Q_j = L_j + C_j, where L_j = e A_j [Gamma_e,j (2 T_e + max(0, phi_p - V_j)) + Gamma_i,j T_e / 2] is the energy the RF-heated electron population loses through surface j (EQ-07), and C_j = I_j (phi_p - V_j) is the energy exchanged with the external circuit at surface j (I_j = net positive current from the plasma into j). Floating surfaces have I_j = 0, so Q_j = L_j. sum_j C_j = P_icp_collector_bias_W = -sum_j I_j V_j. RF-powered keys use L_j; bias-powered keys use C_j.

keys_prescribed_W.Q_icp_plasma_wall_W: RF-powered plasma heat on the neutralizer surfaces in contact with the plasma: sum of L_j over those surfaces plus formation energy released by wall recombination / neutralization, wall-quenched excitation and neutral energy relaxed at the walls. Node split predicted by NP-ICP from the per-surface fluxes over the registered surface -> node map (IN-10 thermal_node in N_VESSEL, N_ANTENNA if exposed, N_MOUNT, N_COLLECTOR, N_HOUSING); the wall-quenched-excitation and neutral-relaxation shares are area-weighted (declared assumption, flag AREA_WEIGHTED_NEUTRAL_TERMS).
keys_prescribed_W.Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W: I_ant,rms^2 R_ant: the whole non-plasma antenna-circuit loss at RP-ANT (RP-ANT convention, EQ-12). Coil-conductor share to N_ANTENNA; induced (eddy) shares to N_COLLECTOR / N_HOUSING / N_MOUNT only as a registered split; NP-ICP v1 does not predict the induced split (NOT_EVALUATED when unregistered).
keys_prescribed_W.Q_icp_match_W: matching-network loss from the P2 two-port; to N_MATCH iff match_colocated (ICD ICP-13, registered), else booked at the PPU/RF boundary B_PPU_RF. The line loss is not inside this key (Q_icp_line_W).
keys_prescribed_W.Q_icp_extraction_W: L_ec: energy carried out of the RF-heated electron population by the extracted electrons through the extraction boundary. EXPORT: deposited on no neutralizer node (bench: dedicated electron collector; flight: Hall plume / anode).
keys_prescribed_W.Q_icp_radiation_W: optical / UV radiation leaving the plasma volume (optically thin). NP-ICP v1 reports the total only; the split f_rad over ICP nodes, H-1 faces and EXPORT is registered on the consumer side (IK-05), never predicted here.
keys_prescribed_W.P_icp_rf_forward_W: forward RF power at RP-CPL; consumer reference only
keys_prescribed_W.P_icp_bus_W: ICP demand at the spacecraft DC boundary = sum of installed slots icp_rf_source + icp_matching_network + icp_collector_bias (+ icp_assist_magnet, flow_control_icp_feed when a declared variant installs them); consumer reference only

keys_additional_W.P_icp_rf_reflected_W: reflected RF power at RP-CPL. Booked at the bus / PPU boundary: absorbed in the RF source and contained in Q_icp_rf_generator_loss_W (IF-ICP-BUS-v1); never on a neutralizer node and never counted a second time.
keys_additional_W.Q_icp_line_W: 50-ohm line / feedthrough loss between RP-CPL and RP-MIN; booked at B_PPU_RF unless a co-located segment is registered (then N_MATCH)
keys_additional_W.P_icp_collector_bias_W: power delivered by the ICP collector / bias supply output into the plasma-electrode circuit, = -sum_j I_j V_j = sum_j C_j. Its DC input is on bus slot icp_collector_bias and its conversion loss Q_icp_bias_supply_loss_W is booked at the bus / PPU boundary (IF-ICP-BUS-v1). Its deposition is reported only by the two keys below, never inside the RF-powered keys.
keys_additional_W.Q_icp_bias_collector_W: bias-supply-powered heat on neutralizer electrodes (sum of C_j over them; ion-collecting electrode -> N_COLLECTOR). Signed: >= 0 while the electrode collects net ions below phi_p.
keys_additional_W.Q_icp_bias_export_W: bias-supply-powered energy at the electron sink (C_ec). EXPORT. Signed.
keys_additional_W.Q_icp_outflow_upstream_W: RF-powered ion, electron and formation energy leaving through the upstream open end toward the H-1 exit face (landing split not predicted by NP-ICP v1)
keys_additional_W.Q_icp_outflow_downstream_W: the same through the downstream open end (plume / space), excluding the extraction term. EXPORT.

IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.why_additional_keys: The seven prescribed keys alone cannot close P_icp_rf_forward_W: reflected power, line loss, the collector-bias supply and the open-end outflow have no prescribed key (consumer CF-04 names the bias supply and reflected power). They are added, not substituted; the prescribed keys keep the consumer meaning (IK-01..IK-07).
IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.closure: RF: P_icp_rf_forward_W = P_icp_rf_reflected_W + Q_icp_line_W + Q_icp_match_W + Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W + P_icp_abs_W. RF-powered plasma: P_icp_abs_W = Q_icp_plasma_wall_W + Q_icp_extraction_W + Q_icp_radiation_W + Q_icp_outflow_upstream_W + Q_icp_outflow_downstream_W. Bias: P_icp_collector_bias_W = Q_icp_bias_collector_W + Q_icp_bias_export_W. Each relative residual <= 1e-10 (CC-04, CC-05). Combined: P_icp_rf_forward_W + P_icp_collector_bias_W = P_icp_rf_reflected_W + Q_icp_line_W + Q_icp_match_W + Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W + Q_icp_plasma_wall_W + Q_icp_extraction_W + Q_icp_radiation_W + Q_icp_outflow_upstream_W + Q_icp_outflow_downstream_W + Q_icp_bias_collector_W + Q_icp_bias_export_W. With no bias supply this is P_icp_rf_forward_W = sum of the partition.
IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.consumer_check_compatibility: IFI-2 (values >= 0) holds for the five deposited prescribed keys by construction; IFI-3 (P_forward <= P_bus) and IFI-4 / IFI-5 (sum of the five <= P_bus, <= P_forward) follow from the closures when the registered eta_RF satisfies P_icp_rf_source_DC_W >= P_icp_rf_forward_W (CC-06).
IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.bounding_pair: When any inelastic channel has disposition UNRESOLVED (IN-23), the keys are emitted for two assignments, ALL_RADIATED and ALL_WALL, each closing exactly; when IN-18 is unsourced, for gamma = 0 and gamma = 1. The thermal model consumes the pair as an envelope.
IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1.coupled_iteration: The ICP model is evaluated at given temperatures and never iterates thermally itself. The system orchestrator owns the ICP-thermal fixed point and its convergence status; a non-converged coupled iteration is MODEL_ERROR at system level.

conservation_checks.check: particle balance per ion and neutral species: |production - loss| / max(production, loss)
element conservation (N, O, Xe, Ar atoms): atoms entering (feed and background inflow) = atoms leaving through every open boundary as neutrals or ions; walls return every incident atom as a neutral
charge / current: sum over all surfaces of I_j, each floating surface individually, and ion production current = total ion loss current
RF chain: P_fwd = P_refl + Q_line + Q_match + Q_coil_ohmic + P_abs
RF-powered plasma closure, bias closure and the combined IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1 closure, every bounding assignment separately; the five deposited prescribed keys >= 0
conservation_checks.tolerance: <= 1e-10 relative to P_fwd + P_collector_bias (to P_abs + P_collector_bias in CM-ABS)

conservation_checks.check: bus: P_icp_bus_W = sum of installed ICP slot inputs; every conversion loss >= 0 (efficiency in (0, 1]); P_icp_rf_source_DC_W >= P_icp_rf_forward_W (declared assumption: the generator produces the forward wave from DC and does not recover reflected power; a registered eta_RF violating this is refused as an inconsistent registration, MODEL_ERROR)
formation-energy bookkeeping: energy created in the volume = energy released at surfaces + energy carried out

conservation_basis: CLAUDE.md rule 4: source mass / power balances close exactly. The tolerances are numerical-policy values for IEEE double after a solve to TOL-SOLVE = 1e-12; they are not physics numbers. No balance term is computed as a remainder, so the checks test the solve and the bookkeeping; they cannot by themselves detect a physics error in a source term (same caveat as the repository interstage energy gate).

analytic_limiting_cases.name: T_e fixed by particle balance, independent of power
analytic_limiting_cases.setup: SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY single atomic gas, one singly charged ion, fixed n_g (REGISTERED_PRESSURE), only ionization (synthetic rate), explicit h on all-floating surfaces, CM-ABS
analytic_limiting_cases.criterion: T_e at P_abs in {P_1, 10 P_1, 100 P_1} equal to each other and to the independent bisection root of n_g k_iz(T_e) V = u_B(T_e) sum_j h_j A_j, relative difference <= 1e-9
analytic_limiting_cases.basis: exact consequence of EQ-03 when n_e cancels (model-derived); textbook statement verify (VER-01)

analytic_limiting_cases.name: n_e linear in absorbed power at fixed T_e; floating-wall energy per pair
analytic_limiting_cases.criterion: n_e / P_abs equal across the three powers and equal to 1 / (e u_B sum_j h_j A_j (E_iz + 2 T_e + T_e/2 + V_s)), V_s = (T_e/2) ln(M / (2 pi m_e)); relative difference <= 1e-9
analytic_limiting_cases.basis: Lieberman 2015 slides 41, 48, 50 (registered); exact under the LC-01 conditions

analytic_limiting_cases.name: zero absorbed power
analytic_limiting_cases.setup: CM-ABS with P_abs = 0; CM-CAL / CM-PRED with P_fwd > 0 evaluated on the n_e = 0 branch
analytic_limiting_cases.criterion: status CONVERGED, plasma_state NOT_SUSTAINED, n_e = 0, I_e_cap_A = 0, I_production_A = 0 and every plasma partition key = 0 exactly; in CM-CAL / CM-PRED the forward power closes into P_refl + Q_line + Q_match + Q_coil_ohmic exactly (R_p = 0); CM-PRED lists the trivial branch separately from any n_e > 0 equilibrium

analytic_limiting_cases.name: coupling efficiency -> 1 as coil resistance -> 0
analytic_limiting_cases.setup: EQ-12 with fixed R_p > 0 and R_ant / R_p in {1, 1e-3, 1e-6, 0}
analytic_limiting_cases.criterion: eta_p = 1 / (1 + R_ant / R_p) to <= 1e-12 relative; at R_ant = 0: eta_p = 1 and Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W = 0 exactly

analytic_limiting_cases.name: I_e,cap bounded by the electron thermal flux through the extraction area
analytic_limiting_cases.setup: CFG-CAP-OFF verification suite including A_ic >> A_ec with V_ec above phi_p
analytic_limiting_cases.criterion: I_e_cap_A <= (1/4) e h_ec n_e vbar_e A_ec (1 + 1e-12) in every case; in the A_ic >> A_ec saturation case the equality holds to <= 1e-9 relative

analytic_limiting_cases.name: I_e,cap bounded by ion collection and by production

analytic_limiting_cases.name: floating sheath, single species
analytic_limiting_cases.setup: EQ-08, one ion species, argon mass
analytic_limiting_cases.criterion: V_s = (T_e/2) ln(M / (2 pi m_e)) to <= 1e-12 relative; V_s / T_e rounds to 4.7 for argon

analytic_limiting_cases.name: Lieberman worked example
analytic_limiting_cases.setup: argon, T_e = 3.5 V; R = 0.15 m, L = 0.3 m, lambda_i = 0.03 m
analytic_limiting_cases.criterion: u_B rounds to 2.9e3 m/s; h_R = 0.8/3 and h_L = 0.86/sqrt(8) to <= 1e-12 relative; both round to 0.3; h_R -> 0.4 as lambda_i -> infinity

analytic_limiting_cases.name: free-molecular effusion

test_rule: Rust-era rule (A9.29 sec. 9 RM-OQ-05): cargo test --workspace --locked; no active test is ignored or skipped; missing evidence is asserted as the fail-closed status; tests that need hardware data go in a separately registered class with reason, evidence basis, environment and trigger.

principles: No synthetic Python reference is required or created (A9.29 sec. 4).
Admission uses conservation, analytic limiting cases, applicable published evidence, P1/P2 hardware evidence when available and the preregistered comparison criteria below.

Calibration data are never reused as validation evidence for the quantity they calibrated. In CM-CAL the P2 impedance at a point is calibration; the validated quantity must be a different measurand (I_e,cap, T_e, n_e, p_ICP, collector heat) or a P2 point outside the calibration partition.
No retuning: no parameter is adjusted after any comparison is seen. A model change is a new model_version with a new preregistration.
Published data are evidence, not truth (docs/EVIDENCE.md); disagreements are first checked against geometry, facility, boundary conditions, diagnostics, chemistry and regime.

comparison_criteria.name: point agreement
comparison_criteria.rule: z = (y_model - y_meas) / sqrt(u_input^2 + u_meas^2), standard uncertainties (k = 1), u_input = input-propagated model uncertainty (u_model_form excluded, to avoid circularity). CONSISTENT if |z| <= 2; INCONSISTENT if |z| > 2.
comparison_criteria.precedent: k_x = 2 frozen for normalized agreement (A9.1 UBQ-04); k_agreement = 2.0 (A9.14 P2Q-06)

comparison_criteria.name: one-sided bound test
comparison_criteria.rule: where the model can only give an upper bound (e.g. P_abs <= P_net when eta_p is unknown): FALSIFIED if y_meas - y_model,UB > 2 u_meas; otherwise NOT_FALSIFIED (never 'validated').

comparison_criteria.name: informativeness
comparison_criteria.rule: the ratio r_u = u_input / u_meas is reported with every comparison; no threshold is set here (OQ-NPICP-13).

comparison_criteria.name: domain cell
comparison_criteria.rule: validation is recorded per cell (supply / evidence mode x configuration x coupling mode x geometry id). A cell is VALIDATED_BENCH when every point of its frozen validation set is CONSISTENT and none is NOT_EVALUATED; one INCONSISTENT point makes the cell INCONSISTENT. Cells never transfer (an Ar cell never validates N2 or air).

comparison_criteria.name: sign and measurand mapping
comparison_criteria.rule: model I_e_cap_A is mapped to the owner terminal sign convention (P1-IT-42 / P1-IT-48) by a registered adapter; only ICP45_CAPACITY records with all four A9.5 P1Q-16 eligibility conditions met are comparison points; Hall-ON NEUTRALIZATION_CONSISTENCY records are never I_e,cap comparison points.

comparison_criteria.name: freeze before data
comparison_criteria.rule: each validation set (record ids, measurands, partition) is frozen with a sha256 before its data are inspected; the partition rule itself is OQ-NPICP-07.

admission_rule.software_admission: The model is admitted as VERIFIED when, on the integration line: (1) this preregistration and its lock are committed; (2) abep-icp passes every LC, CC, NV and FC item above under cargo test --workspace --locked; (3) the abep-chem rate evaluator it uses is admitted (SC-WP-03); (4) every 'verify' item on an admitted code path is cleared by a verification addendum; (5) an admission record pins the Rust commit, the test log and this lock's sha256.
admission_rule.partial_admission: Code paths are admitted separately: the core (CFG-CAP-OFF, CM-ABS) may be VERIFIED while CM-PRED stays NOT ADMISSIBLE (VER-03..05) and CM-CAL stays without data.
admission_rule.validation_status: Admission is software admission. Every output carries validation_status NOT_VALIDATED until a domain cell reaches VALIDATED_BENCH under VC-04 (plan programme rule: a NEW_PHYSICS model is admitted as verified).
admission_rule.simulation_complete_role: With the core VERIFIED and every unavailable quantity failing closed, the model fills the predictive RF/ICP block of the A9.29 sec. 15 chain. 'Software complete' never turns NOT_EVALUATED into PASS (A9.28 msg 2 sec. 14).

uncertainty_handling.rule: Every input carries a registered representation: interval (a manufacturer bound +/- a is rectangular, u = a / sqrt(3), A9.1 UBQ-03), normal with stated u and k, a discrete scenario set, or a physical bound ([0, 1] for probabilities).

Epistemic choices are an unweighted scenario set, never weighted: chemistry variants (DI upper / lower, N elastic OPM / Wang, Johnson-low, rot-off, HMS low / high, N2 dication), disposition assignments (ALL_RADIATED / ALL_WALL), gamma bounds (0 / 1). Outputs are reported per scenario and as the envelope across scenarios.

Parametric inputs are propagated by seeded sampling under the registered Rust RNG policy (abep-rng, SC-WP-10; RM-OQ-03 allows the registered Rust policy for new campaigns). Seed and sample count are recorded. N starts at 1024 and doubles until the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of every reported output change by <= 1 % relative, up to 65536; otherwise the envelope is MODEL_ERROR (point outputs unaffected).
Each output reports nominal, p2.5, p97.5, min, max, u_input and u_model_form (OUT-13). The one-sided lower bound used by HC-05 is formed in assessment, not here.
u_model_form is NOT_EVALUATED until validation residuals exist in the domain cell; it is never assumed.
Rate evaluation: the difference between the direct Maxwellian integral and the registered 1 eV .dat interpolation is reported per reaction at the solution and enters the envelope as a scenario pair.
Uncertainties are never narrowed relative to their producer's record and never replaced by a smaller value.
